title: Fools Rise Tweaks
description: Small mod for Fools Rise modpack! Added progression for modpack and some more!
body:
# Fools Rise Tweaks

**Fools Rise Tweaks** is the core progression and balancing mod designed specifically for the **Fools Rise** modpack. It completely reshapes the traditional Minecraft journey, forcing players to master alternative dimensions before conquering the vanilla world, while also adding custom exploration content and balancing boss fights.

---

## Reimagined Dimension Progression

Forget everything you know about Minecraft progression. You no longer start your main journey in the Overworld. This mod enforces a strict, custom dimensional path that players must follow to unlock the game's full potential:

Aether -> Eternal Starlight -> The End -> The Nether -> The Overworld

You must conquer the skies of the **Aether** and survive the dim lands of **Eternal Starlight** long before you can even think about stepping into the Nether or fully mastering the Overworld.

---

## Custom Dungeons & Exploration

* **The Starter Dungeon:** To support this unique progression, the mod alters world generation. A custom dungeon automatically spawns in the **Aether** upon world creation. 
* **High-Stakes Loot:** This dungeon serves as a crucial starting point for players, packed with challenges and essential rewards needed to kickstart your progression.

---

## Boss Fixes & Balancing

To ensure a smooth yet challenging modpack experience, this mod includes built-in tweaks and fixes for various bosses across multiple dimensions. These fixes resolve AI glitches, optimize multiplayer compatibility, and balance boss health/damage scaling to prevent cheesing.

---

## FAQ

**Q: Can I use this mod outside of the Fools Rise modpack?**  
**A:** This mod is highly customized for the specific progression line of the **Fools Rise** modpack. While you can technically install it, it is hardcoded to restrict progression based on mods like *The Aether* and *Eternal Starlight*, so it is highly recommended to use it only within the official pack.
